en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Shuayb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The perfume in the moustache is from the mannerism of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> and a prestige for the two Scribes (recording Angels)’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Shu’ayb from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Applying perfume is of moral discipline of the Prophets and honoring the scribes (the two angels on one’s shoulders).”’
